assumptions: Uncalibrated authored training fixture; points are not a real-world safety assessment.
The actor supplies a fixed 50 ms simulation clock and committed samples at least every 100 ms.
The affected shuttle is at the curated route entrance when the obstruction is triggered.
The obstruction clears ten simulated seconds after detection; simulated assistance clears it within five seconds of escalation.
All three responses are acceptable when current validation passes and all required stops remain served.
Response points use simulation time, excluding shared pauses; server wall time is recorded separately.
Service and energy consequences are estimates from the road fixture; actual battery integration belongs to the energy actor.
Local lane passing is unavailable; this fixture only validates road-network detours.
